name: OpenSCAD Web
description: OpenSCAD in the browser via openscad-playground (OpenSCAD compiled to WebAssembly), served by nginx. Rendering runs on the client device; bundled libraries include BOSL2, MCAD and more.

notes.text: The app has no login. If exposing it through a reverse proxy, protect it (e.g. an Access List in Nginx Proxy Manager).
Projects are stored in each browser's local storage and do not sync between devices.
2 GB RAM is needed for the build; after install you can lower it to 512 MB (raise it again before running update).
